Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5728190. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728190. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
